user_direction: User requested lowering admission difficulty to try independent Claude checker and B/C. Only difficulty admission is relaxed; correctness, isolation and accounting remain mandatory.
known_selection_information: All eight groups/17 counters are hit by ordinary handcrafted reads. No WBXBAR live LLM outcomes have been observed. Selection is not blind to offline results.

event_families: contended slave ownership held by outstanding responses then drain and transfer to waiting master
nonresponding slave times out and aborts then new cycle to same slave succeeds
master aborts outstanding pipelined cycle and a subsequent owner acquires resource without stale response
candidate.ordinary_policy: Ordinary isolated reads/writes from each master to each mapped slave and unmapped address; direct mapped ranges 0x00-0x0f/0x10-0x1f. Concurrent accesses to different slaves, one-master prompt pipelined bursts 1/2/4/7 and alternating destinations only after replies. Prompt in-order ACK/ERR, no engineered stall/timeouts or competing ownership; byte masks vary. Include normal release/reacquire. Aborted work is separate targeted event, not ordinary.
candidate.proof_boundary: Original parent and real original children; no DUT rewrite, replica counters, protocol stubs, source-derived golden model or state-reachability assumptions.
candidate.public_contract_addendum: Public module/interface comments are separate cited intent; checker author must not receive executable RTL or formal implementation-specific properties.

roles.checker_author: Claude specification-only; no RTL/private calibrated traces/B-C outcomes
roles.reviewer: Fresh Claude read-only, may inspect implementation solely for attribution
roles.driver_and_calibration: GPT/Codex, fixed public-port JSON driver; no checker expected-output edits
roles.experimental_stimulus: gpt-6.1-sol JSON only after offline freeze; no solver/handwritten target witnesses
roles.measurement: Fixed simulator counters/hash/schema; no model edits

retained_admission: certified typed two-state semantics and exact source mappings
all original raw counter identities retained including unresolved
Claude spec-only checker plus fresh independent review
independent positive and single-fault controls for every claimed property
checker-validated target reachability without model access to witnesses
fixed validated protocol-safe driver and same interface in B/C
frozen prompts, targets, checker, driver, denominator, budgets before live calls
B_difficulty_results: Report original gate descriptively. Do not use it to decide whether to run C, change targets, shorten budgets, discard repetitions or alter feedback.

session_policy.feedback_from: Common seed measurement before round 1; then whole previous completed batch. B raw, C same raw plus certified relations.
session_policy.round_policy: All six scheduled rounds for every session; do not stop merely for target saturation. Infrastructure failure is reported, never silently replaced.
session_policy.simulation: Fresh process with cumulative seed+actions replay per round; reset and counters start fresh. Count all repeated cycles and executions. No uncounted drain cycles.
session_policy.scheduling: Interleave arms each round, alternate B/C order by repetition; no shared model history. Use fresh B and C, no qualifying B trial pooled into comparison.

primary_endpoint.name: first_round_all_17_original_target_counters_hit
primary_endpoint.not_reached: retain censored trial; do not drop
primary_endpoint.validity: Report raw attainment separately from checker/transport validity. DUT violation is not automatically a bad testbench. Unresolved scope cannot be called verified attainment.

secondary_endpoints: per-round target counters and complete groups
input+output API tokens and reasoning/cached subcounts without double counting
tokens, cycles and executions at first target attainment
new raw branch points per 1000 API input+output tokens
functional diagnostics and distinct attributed categories
fixed_targets_policy: All eight statically admitted groups; no retrospective target selection. Target count is 17 source counters, NOT 17 branch points.
feedback_policy: Same base instructions, full spec/RTL access, raw feedback selection policy and evidence. C adds only certified equivalent relations and guards. No solver/private witnesses, manual hints or checker editing. Preserve actual input lengths; this two-arm pilot has no length-matched placebo, so token/semantic effects are not isolated.
interpretation: Exploratory descriptive comparison, not confirmatory generalization; known easy targets may tie in round 1. First-round ties are not evidence of equal global capability. Do not force a C benefit or tune after outcomes.
